guard: cmux refuses unsafe environment names before creating its shell launcher

mutations.name: allow shell syntax in environment names
mutations.find:
if (!/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(k))
      throw new Error(`cmux: refusing to render unsafe env var name ${JSON.stringify(k)}`);
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: unsafe env name is refused
